headline: Tobacco permit suspension hearings for 7/Eleven and Lowell Quick Stop over sales to minors.
summary: 7/Eleven and Lowell Quick Stop Corp. were each fined $1,000 for sales to a minor, and both fines are marked paid. The agenda also lists inspection reports, a PrideStar opioid report, and division updates.
items: Tobacco control monthly report from Cesar Pungirum, Program Director
Tobacco permit suspension hearings: 7/Eleven and Lowell Quick Stop Corp., sale to a minor
Development Services inspection reports, including new establishment and failed inspection reports, from Matthew Sheehan, Sr., Sanitary Code Inspector
PrideStar EMS opioid report from Jon Kelley
Departmental and divisional reports: public health, school health, and substance abuse
location: Mayor's Reception Room, 375 Merrimack St., 2nd floor, Lowell, MA 01852
